growth_stages.transplanting_to_tillering: Maintain 2-3 cm shallow standing water layer for seedling establishment and tillering.
growth_stages.panicle_initiation_to_flowering: Critical water stage: Maintain 5 cm continuous standing water. Water stress here causes high spikelet sterility.
growth_stages.dough_to_ripening: Maintain saturated soil (alternate wetting and drying). Drain completely 10-14 days before harvest.

soil_considerations: Clay and clay-loam soils have high water retention. For sandy-loam soils, practice AWD (Alternate Wetting and Drying) to save 25-30% irrigation water.
guidelines: FAO-56 Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56 & ICAR-NRRI Water Management Protocol

growth_stages.seedling_establishment: Light daily watering (2-3 L/m²) for initial 7-10 days after transplanting.
growth_stages.vegetative_growth: Irrigate at 4-6 day intervals depending on soil texture (30-35 mm per irrigation).
growth_stages.flowering_and_fruit_set: CRITICAL STAGE: Uniform moisture essential. Moisture fluctuations cause Blossom End Rot (calcium deficiency) and flower abortion.
growth_stages.fruit_maturation_and_harvest: Moderate irrigation; avoid sudden heavy watering which leads to fruit cracking and split skins.

soil_considerations: Well-drained sandy loam or red loamy soil with pH 6.0-7.0. Use drip irrigation with 2-4 LPH drippers spaced 30 cm apart.
guidelines: FAO Irrigation Guidelines for Solanaceous Vegetables

growth_stages.germination_to_seedling: First irrigation 3-4 weeks after sowing if monsoon rain is absent.
growth_stages.square_formation_to_flowering: Critical Stage 1: Irrigate at 12-15 day intervals.
growth_stages.boll_development: Critical Stage 2: Adequate moisture required for boll expansion and fiber length.
growth_stages.boll_bursting: Cease irrigation when 20-30% bolls have opened to encourage uniform opening and prevent fungal boll rot.

soil_considerations: Deep black cotton soils (vertisols) have high moisture holding capacity; avoid over-irrigation to prevent waterlogging and root asphyxiation.
guidelines: CICR Nagpur & FAO-56 Crop Water Manual

growth_stages.crown_root_initiation_CRI: 20-25 days after sowing (DAS) — MOST CRITICAL IRRIGATION STAGE.
growth_stages.milking_dough_stage: 100-105 DAS — ensures test grain weight. Avoid heavy watering in windy weather to prevent crop lodging.

soil_considerations: Loam to clay loam soils. Typically requires 4 to 6 irrigations of 60 mm each throughout the season.
